resolved_findings: Approximate t assumptions, finite moments versus normality, Bonferroni endpoints, no power guarantee, and achieved-width stopping disclosed.
Historical matched-B3 point tables kept distinct from common-B3 new-study gates.
Training IDs, unique complete groups, disjoint query groups and train/support/query joins enforced.
B2 and deliberately opposite-phase donor clearly scoped; no generic donor-mixture or overall safe-personalization claim.
Weak/nontransfer/mixed descriptive recovery and NRMSE/RMS use declared floors; no sensitivity rescue gates.
Selection replay binds exact finite candidate, common comparator, count and confirmation contract.
Exact resource inventory with finite nonnegative receipts, aggregate ceiling and RESOURCE_STOP veto enforced.
Exclusive execution lock and preflight stopped/exhausted-account checks prevent concurrent or stopped execution; final verification rejects outstanding lock.
Manifest realization/regime bound to exact contract; exact file inventory, parameter counts/norms/timing and objective/probability replay enforced.
Development expected contract and factorial report exactly replayed; incomplete evidence cannot become no-candidate success.
scientific_assessment: Four adaptation pairs and five global weights produce20 declared settings,18 distinct at zero weight; matching-offset B3 used inside blends and independently development-selected common B3 used for primary risk/usefulness.
Same histories and shared fitted heads across policies; seed probabilities averaged before blending/scoring, schedules averaged within realization; no regime-specific inference policy.
Fresh development and reserved confirmation banks; fixed12 development worlds and prospective24-96 confirmation count, no confirmation-based extension.
Two null upper bounds and strong-gain lower bound use alpha=.05/3; independent realizations, not people/schedules/seeds, are primary inference units.
Nontransfer target shift is unobservable to learner and explicitly stress-only; no impossible detection gate.
w=0 cannot qualify, and positive gain/recovery/contrast requirements prevent null control alone from being called recovered interaction.

limitations: Approximate Student-t/CLT coverage is not a finite-sample distribution-free95% safety guarantee.
Development-selected SD underestimates uncertainty in planning; actual confirmation-width gate and no-extension rule limit claims but do not guarantee power.
Expected incremental risk versus common B3 is not per-world/person safety, source-blind noninferiority, or real-human predictive validity.
Logical train/support/evaluator boundary is not OS isolation; source joins and hashes verify consistency, not cryptographic proof of historical execution.

Mock fits, objectives and selected-path scores are fabricated engineering fixtures; real optimization convergence, generator behavior and statistical coverage have not been scientifically tested by this planning package.
CPU/RSS watchdog samples every50ms, can overshoot within one interval, and fitting-process accounting excludes separately disclosed supervisor/replay overhead.
Public seeds/design are reserved but no fresh scientific world was materialized in this review.
